verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS registrar, but the evidence shows no assistant inside Porkbun itself. The official MCP server connects external clients such as Claude and Cursor to the account, and the llms.txt guides are written for outside agents. These are integration building blocks for third-party agents, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
